item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We must act before that threshold is crossed—not count on regaining control afterward.

2. We cannot regulate our way out of losing control to superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control its actions. We demand prevention before promises of oversight become meaningless.

3. We reject the promise that governments can always keep AI under control. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, they will be unable to control what it does. We must stop treating that future as inevitable.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a stark reality: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We cannot accept assurances that laws, regulators or emergency powers will restore control after that threshold has been crossed. We must focus on preventing this outcome, not preparing comforting promises about managing it. We demand that governments put public safety ahead of the race to build ever more powerful systems. We refuse to treat the loss of human control as an acceptable price of progress. Our task is clear: we must act now, while the decisions shaping that future remain ours to make.
